name: Ciel
source:
The spirited princess of Amarine, but only because her father overthrew the old corrupted government. Ciel dislikes her status and the formalities that come with it, wishing to venture to the outside world. Going against her father's wishes, she runs away from home with two knight brothers, Florien and Anton.

Naive but with a sound and kind heart, Ciel's journey helps her grow for the better until the day she can properly communicate with her father.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12607140.ciel]official bio[/url]]
